description: Ctrl-F regex search '/armour|battleaxe' → 2 matches, describe each, Esc, Esc. The highlight lands in the robe's stat chip row ('Base <lightcyan>armour<lightgrey> rating: 2       Encumbrance rating: 0') and in a continuation line of the battleaxe's Flame: brand block. Wizard-created battleaxe, so the bodies carry the wizard-only prefix and xp/skp lines

messages.title: a - a +0 robe (worn).
messages.body:
<lightgrey>

A large, loose-fitting, wide-sleeved outer garment made of light cloth. It offers little protection against physical harm, but does not hinder evasion or spellcasting. 

Base <lightcyan>armour<lightgrey> rating: 2       Encumbrance rating: 0

It can be maximally enchanted to +2.

If you take off this armour:
Your AC would decrease by 2.0 (4.0 -> 2.0).
Your EV would remain unchanged.


Stash search prefixes: {inventory} {body armour} {body armor}
Menu/colouring prefixes: identified equipped armour
_________________

<darkgrey>“CLEOPATRA: Give me my robe, put on my crown; I have
 Immortal longings in me”
    -William Shakespeare, _Anthony & Cleopatra_, V, ii. ca. 1605.
<lightgrey>SPELLSET_PLACEHOLDER

messages.title: The +3 battleaxe of the Shallot {flame, rCorr Dex+3}.
messages.body:
<lightgrey>

A large war axe with a formidable double-sided head. 

Base accuracy: -4  Base damage: 15  Base attack delay: 1.7
This weapon's minimum attack delay (0.7) is reached at skill level 20.
    Your skill: 0.0
    At 100% training you would reach 20.0 in about 12.9 XLs.
    (621191 xp, 17288 skp)
    Current attack delay: 1.7.
Damage rating: 19 (Base 15 x 112% (Str) x 100% (Skill) + 3 (Ench)).

Flame:     It burns victims, dealing an additional one-quarter of any damage
           that pierces defenders' <lightcyan>armour<lightgrey>. Big, fiery blades are also staple
           armaments of hydra-hunters.

rCorr:     It protects you from acid and corrosion.
Dex+3:     It affects your dexterity (+3).

If you switch to wielding this weapon:
Your EV would increase by 0.1 (8.9 -> 9.0).

This weapon falls into the 'Axes' category. It hits all enemies adjacent to the wielder, dealing less damage to those not targeted. It is a two-clawed weapon.

It cannot be enchanted further.

This ancient artefact cannot be changed by magic or mundane means.

Stash search prefixes: {artefact} {artifact} {Axes} {two-handed} {flame} {melee weapon}
Menu/colouring prefixes: identified melee artefact weapon
_________________

<darkgrey>“On Carian coins, indeed of quite late date, the labrys, set up on its long
 pillar-like handle, with two dependent fillets, has much the appearance of a
 cult image.”
    -Sir Arthur John Evans, “Mycenaean tree and pillar cult and its
     Mediterranean relations,” _Journal of Hellenic Studies_ XXI, p. 109. 1901.
<lightgrey>SPELLSET_PLACEHOLDER
